description: SIGN UP or sign in to Light Cloud with an email — the only account step needed. An email with no account gets one (Free plan, no card, no password, no form) when the user approves a short code at console.light-cloud.com/device from any device; an existing account just signs in. No browser is needed on this machine. Then call connect-status to wait for the approval. Use this whenever the user is not signed in, has no account, or asks to sign up / create an account / get started.

email.description: The email address to sign in (or sign up) with

name: connect
